title: ADVERSARIAL ALIGNMENT: ENSURING VALUE CONSISTENCY IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR SENSITIVE DOMAINS
findings: The proposed model, VC-LLM, achieved the highest scores in the Religion domain, with a perfect average score of 5.00 in Chinese and 4.95 in English. The study also found that adversarial training significantly improved the model's value alignment, with Religion being one of the domains showing the most notable gains.
